title: Tree Node Focus Misinterprets Joystick Navigation
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
* v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]
* v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]
* v4.5.dev2.official [af2c71397]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS 22.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 4 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (nvidia; 535.183.01) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-3770 CPU @ 3.40GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

When focusing on a `Tree` node with `select_mode` set to "Row" (and 2 columns), I'm seeing movement with a gamepad's left joystick move in the wrong direction:

* Tilting the stick up or down always moves up.
* Tilting the stick left or right always moves down.

Additionally focus moves through multiple elements (2-4) every time I tap the stick in a direction. I'd guess it's moving every frame that the input value changes.

I'm seeing this on these (USB-connected) controllers:
* XBOX
* PS5
* Logitech F310 (in XInput mode + in "fight mode" where the "mode" LED is off)

None of the above issues show up when using the keyboard arrow keys or D-pad buttons on the controller.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the test project and run it with a gamepad plugged in.
2. Try tilting the left stick and observe how the focused row moves.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[TreeNodeTestProject.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19726590/TreeNodeTestProject.zip)
